name: Add a label element
title: Add a line to this channel's label
help_text: Elements print top to bottom in position order. Takealot: Title (1), Barcode (2), Stacked text "MP" (3). Amazon FBA: Barcode (1), Title (2), Text "New" (3) — Amazon requires the item condition at the bottom of every unit label. Text is only used by Text and Stacked text; max lines only by Title. Adding elements shortens the barcode, and the print page warns if the bars end up under 6.35 mm.
